RTE_PAD_solaire_modulation.csv.description: Monthly volume (GWh) of solar output modulated by plants in mainland France, Corsica included, during negative spot price episodes, as estimated by RTE.
RTE_PAD_solaire_modulation.csv.format: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF line ends, ';' separator, decimal comma; header 'Date;Filière;Valeur (GWh)'; three stacked blocks of 82 months, 2020-01 to 2026-10.
RTE_PAD_solaire_modulation.csv.blocks_evidence: Rows 1-82, 83-164 and 165-246 equal, month by month within 1e-9 GWh, the series 'global', 'tripleFiliere1' and 'tripleFiliere2' embedded in the chart of the page, whose filter buttons label them 'Global', 'Jours ouvrés' and 'Jours non ouvrés' (page read on 2026-11-22).
